active.name: Intro to Pathway Evolutions
active.description: Explore Pathway Evolutions, a new type of Evolution that allows you to choose how your player develops and upgrades!

challenges: Play 1 match in Squad Battles on min Semi-Pro difficulty (or Rush/Rivals/Champions/Live Events) using your active EVO player in game.

active.description: Keep the service coming. Upgrade your wide midfielder’s passing and delivery, then run it back for another round and keep feeding your attack from the flanks.
